scope: Portal discovery migration into production browser harness
limitations: Existing cached local production image, not rebuilt from candidate source.
Community discovery collected only; native candidate CI remains unverified.
Generic unknown-address UI confirmation does not prove email delivery, server-action health, or equal responses for existing accounts.
Callback assertion covers browser URL preservation only, not links in delivered mail.

legacyMapping.form and visual structure: heading, explanatory copy and form visibility retained; arbitrary first SVG/body visibility removed as non-behavioral
legacyMapping.tenant hint: credential fields and discovery exclusion, without swallowed wait errors
legacyMapping.success, unknown email, reset: one unique reserved-domain submission and reset journey; no unsupported delivery claim
legacyMapping.required/format: disabled empty submission and actual browser rejection of malformed email
legacyMapping.dashboard/callback: parsed URL return destination and discovery visibility
